project_type: npm workspaces monorepo — Vanilla TypeScript widget + Hono/Cloudflare Workers API server
build_system: npm workspaces (root package.json with workspaces:["packages/*"]). Widget built with esbuild CLI. Server type-checked with tsc --noEmit; bundled/run by wrangler. No separate bundler for the server (wrangler handles it). Windows/PowerShell environment — use forward slashes in npm scripts, avoid Unix-only shell constructs.
test_framework: None in initial scaffold. Add vitest if tests are needed — do NOT add them unless a FEAT explicitly requires it.
build_command: npm run build (root) — chains: npm run build -w packages/widget (esbuild) && npm run build -w packages/server (tsc --noEmit)
test_command: No test suite in scope for this task. Verification is via tsc --noEmit and manual wrangler dev checks.
verification_instructions: 1) From repo root: npm install. 2) npm run build -w packages/widget — should produce packages/widget/dist/pluggable-bot.js < 30 KB gzip. 3) npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json — should exit 0. 4) cd packages/server && npx wrangler dev --port 8787 — server starts. 5) Open demo/index.html in browser via http://localhost:8787 — widget loads, chat works.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/widget/dist/pluggable-bot.js — produced by 'npm run build -w packages/widget'. packages/server/data/knowledge.json — produced at runtime by /api/train calls; gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — do not use bash-specific syntax (&&, $(...), etc.) outside npm script strings. npm scripts using && ARE fine inside package.json scripts because npm uses cmd/sh. Do not use Docker. wrangler dev port 8787 is the primary dev server — do not change the port unless instructed. OPENAI_API_KEY is optional; mock fallback must work without it.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present (empty repo). Follow the plan precisely. All source files must be complete with no TODO stubs. Commit only once per FEAT on the current branch (never push).
key_patterns: 1) Custom Element pattern: class extends HTMLElement, connectedCallback(), attachShadow({mode:'open'}), read config from document.querySelector('script[data-api-url]') in constructor. 2) SSE streaming: server returns new Response(new ReadableStream({start(ctrl){...}}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream'}}). Client uses fetch+body.pipeThrough(new TextDecoderStream()).getReader(). 3) Hono route: app.post('/api/chat', async (c) => { const body = await c.req.json(); return new Response(...) }). 4) CORS: import {cors} from 'hono/cors'; app.use('*', cors()). 5) Workers env: Hono<{Bindings:{OPENAI_API_KEY:string}}>; access via c.env.OPENAI_API_KEY. 6) esbuild IIFE: --format=iife --global-name=PluggableBotLoader auto-executes customElements.define on script load.
directory_structure: pluggable-bot/ (root, npm workspace). packages/widget/ — esbuild-compiled Custom Element widget, outputs dist/pluggable-bot.js. packages/server/ — Hono Workers app, run via wrangler dev; contains data/ for local knowledge.json persistence. demo/ — standalone demo HTML page. .agents/tasks/ — planner artifacts (not committed unless user wants them).
